binary_listing_logic.budget: SLASH_COMMAND_TOOL_CHAR_BUDGET if set, else floor(contextWindow * bytesPerToken * skillListingBudgetFraction)
binary_listing_logic.entry: "- name: " + (description [+ " - " + when_to_use]) cut to 1536 chars with an ellipsis
binary_listing_logic.over_budget: bundled prompt skills keep full text; skillOverrides name-only stay name-only; all others start name-only and are given their full text greedily in usage-score order (usageCount * max(0.5^(days/7), 0.1), from <configdir>/.claude.json skillUsage) while the increment fits
binary_listing_logic.no_listing_when: the context tool set lacks the Skill tool (fn yCn returns [])
binary_listing_logic.sources: claude.exe 2.1.280 fns nUe, JBt, yCn, Fmt, LYe, qke, xf (byte offsets ~178.77M, ~180.34M, ~180.44M)

cost.method:
Price the listing attachments (skill_listing, mcp_instructions_delta, deferred_tools_delta,
agent_listing_delta) and the ToolSearch round trips, from extract.sqlite (xdup=0).

Method (ESTIMATED, list-price weights; the fleet is quota-billed):
  A token that sits in a context's prefix is paid on every later response of that context:
    - response reads the cached prefix (cache_read >= READ_FLOOR tokens) -> in_price * cr_mult
    - otherwise the prefix was (re)written this response -> in_price * (1.25*share_5m + 2.0*share_1h),
      or 1.0x when nothing was cached.
  M(file, s) = sum of that per-token price over the file's responses with seq > s.
  Item cost = tokens(item) * M(file, resp_before(item)); tokens = chars / CPT.
  Priced twice: at each response's own model and re-priced at Opus 5.5 ($4 in, cr 0.05x).
  CPT: 3.0 chars/token is Claude Code's own estimate for Opus 5.x/Fable (fn xf -> 3 bytes/token)
  and matches headless /context (30.1k-char listing ~ 10k tokens); 2.6 chars/token is the ratio
  MEASURED on memory files by /context. Both are reported.
  "Static token value" = sum over contexts of M(file, first listing) = what one extra token in
  every context's initial listing costs over the window.

S0_current.note: real rendered listing: 30,103 chars incl. an ~82-char header; the simulation is len()-based, the binary uses Bun.stringWidth

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: cafe-wifi-optimization
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Client-side ladder for slow GUEST Wi-Fi you cannot administer (cafe, hotel, airport): route, SNR, capacity, bufferbloat direction, and the Wi-Fi vs iPhone-tether call. Not for any network whose router you can log into.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: limit-recover
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Recover delegated work after any interruption (usage or weekly limit, login cliff, network drop, stalled agent or workflow, crash or resume): audit every slot, subagent and teammate from disk, re-run what is incomplete, or move to another account.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: frontier-routing
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Policy for when to use the frontier model (Fable) instead of the default tier: only for unknown-unknowns after research stalls, inside the hook-enforced spawn cap. Points to /frontier-hole, /frontier-run and /frontier-campaign.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: permission-harvest
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Weekly review of manual permission prompts: runs cc-permission-harvest read-only, buckets the prompts, proposes composable prefix allow rules and hands the operator one cc-do apply step. Never writes settings files.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: dia-agent
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Drive the operator's real logged-in Dia browser without consent prompts: AppleScript for tabs, windows and JS; CDP via dia://inspect for trusted input, screenshots, network and cookies; a clean-profile launcher as fallback.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: manual-command-delivery
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Load before asking the user to do anything (login, sudo, a blocked or destructive step): write one re-runnable /tmp script that drives every drivable step, gates irreversible ones behind a typed yes, and hand over one command.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: plan-conventions
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Rules for writing and updating plan or design docs: integrate, never overwrite; compact completed sections; expand upcoming ones with file:line detail; mandatory Phase 0 with a per-wave execution locus. Load when editing a *plan*.md.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: demo-recording
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Record a live screen, terminal or agent demo and embed it in a README as animated WebP (GitHub strips <video>): capture, iTerm2 sizing, near-lossless encode recipe, contact-sheet review. Not for understanding an existing video.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: research-subagents
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Discipline for read-only research fan-out: decomposition artifact, default N=10, a 7-field brief with a file delivery path, adversarial sampling, stop and synthesis rules. Load before spawning research subagents; not for code-writing teammates.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: browsermcp
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: History of the retired BrowserMCP server plus the browser-automation decision tree; the agent-browser CLI is the live path. Load when browser tools report "No such tool available".

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: agent-teams
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Orchestrating code-writing teammates (Agent with name:): runtime detection, 150-line brief rules, pre-spawn checklist, model and effort pinning, lifecycle, shutdown and crash recovery. Load before spawning teammates or planning 2+ code tasks.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: recover
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Front door for recovering delegated work after any interruption (network drop, stalled agent, killed task, crash or resume, quota, login cliff), or for moving a healthy session to another account. Modes: limit, resume-in-place, stall, switch.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: codex-security
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Run OpenAI's Codex Security methodology natively (vendored plugin; no Codex or OpenAI account): repo and diff security scans, threat models, finding validation and triage, fixes, write-ups and SARIF output.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: coding-standards
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: House style for TypeScript, React/Next.js and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic v2, mypy strict, ruff): strictness, exports, Server Components, naming. Load when writing a new component, module or endpoint, or for a style review.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: self-explaining-artifact
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Build a self-contained animated HTML explainer of an article, dataset or mechanism, and verify it with measured gates (word count, AA contrast, frame budget). Use when an explainer was rejected as walls of text or hard to follow.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: repo-wiki
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Generate a source-grounded README or multi-page wiki for a repository in two passes (a structure plan, then pages), with citation and diagram rules and 15 named styles. Use to write a README or document a codebase.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: autonomous-authenticated-web-access
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Choose and run read-only access to a logged-in web app: API token, then clean-profile CDP, then warm Dia CDP; plus trusted-input, shadow-DOM and consent-modal techniques for hardened SPAs. Pairs with dia-agent and agent-browser.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: resume-sessions
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Resume every Claude Code session across the 4 accounts after a crash or reboot: find open sessions, recreate worktrees, take the full session rather than the summary, clear terminal gibberish, re-engage them and keep them alive.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: grok-wiki-audit
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Our recipe for a multi-shard defect sweep of a repo with grok-wiki ask: preflight checks (a broken claude stub, the codex config override), shard design, and verifying each finding against the pre-fix artifact before fixing it.

proposed_skill_descriptions.name: model-upgrade
proposed_skill_descriptions.proposed: Runbook for moving to a new Claude model or off one: the binary gate first (does the pinned Claude Code register the id?), the model-id census, config and doc sweeps, the model ladder. Use when a model ships or frontier access changes.

proposed_agent_descriptions.name: deep-research
proposed_agent_descriptions.proposed: Deep research subagent (Opus tier; the lead may pass model "fable" per model-config.yaml). Default for research fan-out slots and for adversarial or multi-hop briefs. Returns signal-dense findings.

proposed_agent_descriptions.name: deep-research-sonnet
proposed_agent_descriptions.proposed: Sonnet-tier research worker, benched: use only in a probe-certified low- or medium-effort Workflow (~/.claude/model-routing-freewin-probe.md). Otherwise use deep-research.

proposed_agent_descriptions.name: frontier-derivation
proposed_agent_descriptions.proposed: Read-only, baseline-blind panelist for /frontier-run: derives failure modes from the system model first, then reads code to confirm or refute them. One per hole; the lead passes model "fable".
